name: Valentines Moon
source:
You’re just trying to survive high school — keeping your grades up, dodging drama, and pretending Valentine’s Day doesn’t exist. You don’t have time for crushes. Not when your scholarships on the line and your parents are counting on you, yet you find yourself growing close to two very different boys:

They’re sweet. They’re strange. They’re... maybe a little too into you?

[From [url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/valentines-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你只是想在高中生存下来——保持成绩，躲避戏剧性事件，假装情人节不存在。你没有时间暗恋。当你的奖学金岌岌可危、你的父母指望你时，你却发现自己与两个截然不同的男孩越来越亲近：

他们很甜蜜。他们很奇怪。他们……也许有点太喜欢你了？

[来自[url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/valentines-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
